issues.name: Boll rot
ipm_steps: Avoid irrigation during peak humidity periods.
Manage canopy to improve airflow and reduce wetness.
Remove infected bolls from the field and monitor adjacent plants.

issues.name: Jassid damage
ipm_steps: Monitor early-season insect populations and destroy infested weeds.
Use recommended resistant varieties and action thresholds.
Apply registered insecticide only when thresholds are exceeded.

prevention: Use clean seed and avoid high-density canopy stress.
Monitor insects and disease at early crop stages.
Keep moisture and nutrient stress in check.
